Game Overview

Doll Factory 3D is a runner title where immerse yourself in a vibrant 3D factory adventure where you control every aspect of doll production. Navigate thrilling parkour courses, dodge deadly traps, and gather parts to craft unique toys. Unleash your creativity by customizing dolls with various styles and outfits, making each one a masterpiece in this fast-paced, delightful experience!
